children.counts: Simple 4-count rhythm matching vocal song phrases.
children.game_version: Follow-the-leader group game mirroring symmetrical arm extensions in a circle.

seniors.counts: Count 1-2 to extend arms, 3-4 to return hands to heart.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm extensions from the heart outward and skyward while seated upright in a chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform arm gestures from a stable standing position without fast turns or footwork.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Execute arm extensions at a slow, comfortable tempo within natural shoulder mobility.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Stretching arms from the heart outward toward Mao's portrait and reaching up toward the sky.
movement_profile.footwork: Simple movements derived from Xinjiang folk dance; specific steps not described in sources.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Collective mass performance in open plazas, public squares, and parades.
movement_profile.partnering: None; individual synchronised movement within a large mass collective.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, facing public portraits or the sky.

signature_moves.description: Stretching one's arms outward from the heart toward Mao's portrait.
signature_moves.name: Heart to portrait extension

signature_moves.description: Directing arm movements toward the sky to symbolize respect.
signature_moves.name: Skyward reach

music_profile.sound_description: Mass singing of revolutionary anthems featuring brass, choral voices, and explicit ideological lyrics.
music_profile.vocal_style: Mass choral singing of revolutionary songs and lyricized quotations.

basic_steps: Place hand or hands over the heart.
Extend arms outward from the heart toward a portrait of Mao.
Reach arms and gestures upward toward the sky to display respect.
teaching.formation: Mass collective formation in public squares, plazas, or street parades.
teaching.level_notes: Simple, repetitive movement accessible to dancers of all ages and physical capacities.
teaching.rhythm: Set to the tempo and meter of accompanying revolutionary songs.
